candidate_program.name: bounded_rival_correction
candidate_program.rationale: Uses count efficiency as the anchor and applies a small bounded correction for the strongest rival. Reach is local count and maximum weight; arithmetic is constant size, while maximum updates remain charged. Several feasible rivals can defeat the single-rival proxy.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
